title: Preflight a channel-cover slot set
summary: Read a channel-cover spec (required aspect-ratio slots, family naming.pattern, transparencyAllowed) and a delivery directory, observe each present declared file with org.openadam.file.inspect@0.1.0 inspect (File Vitals), then compare namePattern, signature format, width, height, reduced aspect, and transparency, and aggregate missing/extra into ordered checks and a suite status. Optional slots may be absent. The adapter schedules one inspect per present path; there is no portable batch Capability. Comparison is ordinary code and does not implement raster.verify. This Procedure is not brand-asset.prepare and does not generate missing sizes.

stages.title: Inspect declared slot files
stages.purpose: The adapter internally schedules org.openadam.file.inspect inspect once per present declared slot path (JSONL sessions of at most 16; not a portable batch or inventory operation). Each call observes file name, signature format, pixel width/height, and has_alpha when File Vitals can determine it. Missing required paths skip inspect and become missing checks. Optional absent slots are not missing. Extra undeclared files are listed without inspect. namePattern/format/width/height/aspect/transparency/missing/extra comparison is ordinary adapter code in src/compare.mjs and is not raster.verify.

completion.description: Completion is the aggregated preflight report: ordered checks plus suite status pass|fail. That report is combinator output after file.inspect observations, not a raw inspect envelope and not a raster.verify result.

errors.description: The Procedure input is outside the portable contract or the slot spec cannot be parsed.
The delivery root is missing or is not a directory inside the implementation grant.
A requested path is absolute, contains .., or escapes the implementation root.
The slot set exceeds the declared Procedure bound of 32 slots.
The File Vitals inspect adapter, the author compare implementation, or the Procedure adapter failed safely outside a more specific error.
